subject: genarate pdf from shiny program using mpdf

messages.author: ac2d2e4dc0e3cb16
messages.subject: genarate pdf from shiny program using mpdf
parts:
Hello,
Does anyone know whether it is possible to generate a pdf file with mpdf from a shiny file on a shiny server?
My shiny (test)  call is http://demo.dpvragenlijst.nl:3838/sessie.Rmd

One way of calling mdf is a php program:

$page = file_get_contents('http://demo.dpvragenlijst.nl/shiny/sessie.Rmd');
$mpdf->WriteHTML($page);
$mpdf->Output();

This works for html and php pages but not for shiny

Or does anyone know how te generate a pdf from shiny? Its no problem if the file contains only markdown code (using knitr) but pdf as output does not work with a shiny file.
Thanks
Frans
